kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اندلعت (form VII)
# اِنْدَلَعْتُ (indalaʕtu) /in.da.laʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
# اِنْدَلَعْتَ (indalaʕta) /in.da.laʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
# اِنْدَلَعْتِ (indalaʕti) /in.da.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
# اِنْدَلَعَتْ (indalaʕat) /in.da.la.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
